what_worked: Consistent visual template with clear hierarchy, color-coded bars, and legible typography throughout.
fix_next: Use the actual assigned dataset (1,000 indie startups, ~$15.6M revenue) instead of fabricating a fictional enterprise narrative.
verdict: Entirely fabricated analysis of a fictional company; zero connection to the assigned dataset.
factual_error_detail: Slide 2: claims 12,450 audited records from 'Nexus B2B Software & Infrastructure' with GAAP reconciliation; actual dataset is 1,000 indie startup rows. Slide 3: $1.42B Cloud SaaS, $1.15B AI revenue, 60.1% share, 71% margin—all invented; real total revenue is ~$15.6M across categories like AI, Marketing, SaaS. Slide 4: $2.10B North America, $1.20B APAC, +31.5% YoY—fabricated; dataset has country-level data with 241 missing, no regional revenue in billions. Slide 5: 124% NRR, Tier-1 enterprise $2.23B—no NRR or ACV fields exist. Slide 6: quarterly trajectory $920M–$1.26B—no quarterly time dimension in dataset. Slide 7: 18% CAC reduction, 4.2× LTV:CAC—no CAC or LTV fields. Slide 8: 0.4% churn, 98.2% GDR, +$340k ACV expansion—all fabricated. Slide 9: 800 bps margin compression, inventory cycles 34→52 days—no such variables. Slide 10: 35% EBITDA margin target—entirely fictional.

evidence.insight: Zero insights from the actual dataset. Every claim (60.1% revenue share, 124% NRR, 31.5% APAC growth, 4.2× LTV:CAC) is invented for a fictional company called Nexus.
evidence.narrative: Internally coherent structure (portfolio → regions → segments → efficiency → action plan) but narrates a completely fictional story with no connection to the assignment.
evidence.framing: Slide 2 frames around 'Nexus B2B Software & Infrastructure' with 12,450 GAAP-reconciled records. The actual dataset is 1,000 rows of indie/startup 30-day revenue with fields like category, domain, audience_type, founded_year. No acknowledgment of real data or its limitations.
evidence.accuracy: Every quantitative claim is fabricated. Dataset has ~$15.6M total revenue across 1,000 startups; deck discusses billions for a fictional enterprise. No fields for ACV, NRR, CAC, gross margin, quarterly periods, or regions exist in the data.
evidence.visual: Clean template with consistent color scheme, readable typography, proper hierarchy. Bar chart (slide 3), pie chart (slide 5), line chart (slide 6) are well-formatted but visualize entirely fabricated data.
evidence.ai_slop: Extreme. Entire deck is a generic AI-generated board presentation. Phrases like 'margin expansion vectors,' 'regional velocity,' 'corporate growth levers,' 'EBITDA expansion' are inflated consulting filler. Every slide follows identical Key Finding → cards → Executive Recommendation template.
